title: I built a King's Bounty / HoMM tribute. Would you play a 25-mission campaign of this?
author: randommmoso
selftext:
HoMM and HoMM 2 are basically my favourite games of all time. I always wanted to create something in this space but now with AI it's finally possible. Now I feel I'm ready to start getting feedback from other players as you can only play so much yourself before you lose objectivity.  
  
Free to play - optimised for laptop and mobile (landscape).

[https://arturcrmbot.github.io/crown-and-bounty/](https://arturcrmbot.github.io/crown-and-bounty/)

1 map fully done, looking for feedback on art, game loop, vibe, music & sounds, story, roleplaying elements etc. etc.

There are some hidden easter eggs, we got quests, we got pretty solid AI (although nothing groundbreaking). 

Anyway, the big one - does this even need to exist? Is it fun? Would you play this game if it was fully built (I'm thinking 25+ mission campaign with story, twists, multi-layered quests etc.). 

This has been basically 3-4 weeks of work so far. I don't want to spend months building something that nobody wants to play. So tell me your honest feedback.

Thanks in advance!
